title: ensemble.GetEnsemble
description: Response containing a single Ensemble with creation timestamp.

agents.description: The validated and deduplicated LLMs, sorted by full_id.

items.description:
Wrapper that adds fallback agents and a count to any agent type.

Used to specify how many instances of an agent to include in an ensemble,
along with fallback agents to try if the primary fails.

count.description: Number of instances of this agent in the ensemble. Defaults to 1.

fallbacks.description: Fallback agents to try if the primary fails.

created.description: Unix timestamp when this Ensemble was first used.

id.description: The deterministic content-addressed ID (22-character base62 string).
